sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会区長提出議案

name: 公示送達の方法に電子画面を追加
summary: 現在、公示送達は掲示によって行います。この議案では、公示内容を定められた方法で誰でも見られる状態にしたうえで、書面の掲示か、広域連合の事務所にある電子計算機の画面での閲覧を選べるようにします。
changes: 公示事項を定められた方法で不特定多数が閲覧できる状態にする
公示事項を記載した書面の掲示か、広域連合事務所の電子計算機画面での閲覧を選べるようにする
who: 後期高齢者医療で公示送達の対象となる人
why: 地方税法の改正に伴い、電子的な記録を使った公示送達の規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds electronic screens as an option for service by public notice
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ota City Ordinance Concerning Medical Care for Older Senior Citizens
en.summary: Service by public notice is currently carried out by posting. This bill would make the matters being announced available for anyone to view using the prescribed method, then allow a choice between posting a written notice or viewing the matters on a computer screen at the wide-area union's office.
changes: Make the matters being announced available for anyone to view using the prescribed method, and allow a choice between posting a written notice listing them or viewing them on a computer screen at the wide-area union's office
who: People subject to service by public notice under the medical care system for older senior citizens
en.why: The ward says this is to update the rules on service by public notice using electronic records following amendments to the Local Tax Act.
